question: Who among the following is India's richest person as of 6 April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mukesh Ambani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Forbes list of India's billionaire's list which was released in April 2022, Reliance Industries chairperson Mukesh Ambani retained his position as Asia's richest and the tenth richest in the world. His net worth was $90.7 billion at that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **As per current data - April 2023:**
 
• Mukesh Ambani, who holds a net worth of $82 billion, has been crowned as India's wealthiest person and Asia's richest individual.
 
• He has secured a spot in the top 10 of the 2023 M3M Hurun Global Rich List, making him the only Indian to achieve this feat, edging out Gautam Adani. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cyrus Poonawalla, the founder and senior pharma leader of Serum Institute, the world's largest vaccine manufacturer, played a key role in COVID-19.

 
 
• He received the Padma Bhushan 2022 award in the category of Trade and Industry.
 
 
 
• Shiv Nadar is the founder and chairman of HCL Technologies Limited.
 
• Gautam Adani is the Chairman of Adani Group.
